title: A batch runner's standing duty is a rolling combine train, written into decision session-tiers and the project-ops batch-runner template
why: Owner 21:48 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat (relayed by the consultant): the combining should be continuous, with lane PRs always joining a batch, so the runner becomes a scaling machine; if sound, make it part of how a batch runner is briefed and operates.
source: Consultant 21:49 CST Nov 13, relaying runner 10 relaying the owner; retrospective agrees.
note: Triage 21:49 CST Nov 13: duty as the consultant states it: a batch closes when its real PR is built and linted, later hand-ins join the next batch, clashing members leave by name. Each merge report carries per-batch numbers: members in, members left out, clash rate, dry-round minutes, lint minutes and CI minutes. Review after 3 batches against lone merges: does the train save time. Homes: decision session-tiers (batch runner) and the project-ops batch-runner template, via a lane the coordinator assigns; a fresh reviewer reads it, since it changes a role's duty. Rule: no rule or guard changes here; merges stay serial. Unmeasured by triage: whether a train beats lone merges; the review is how that gets measured. Coordinator 21:50 CST Nov 13 (21:50): lane started, session_013NEJL2vjqFYDAqvgfkZRN3 (Sonnet, medium). Scope: the duty in two homes, decision session-tiers (batch runner section) and the project-ops batch-runner template; the template points to the decision, no copy; no rule or guard change; a fresh reviewer reads it. Overlap by title search (unchecked by triage), open PRs touching those files: #3259, #3247, #3159, #3117, #3057, #2920, #2860, #2747, #2709, #2701. The lane reads each diff, makes its edit a small additive section, and names "Merge after: ...". Path: a combined docs PR via runner 10, in the next batch. Owner 21:52 CST (relayed by the consultant; ruling own-rolling-combine-train part 2): the batch in CI and the next in line are frozen; every batch behind them keeps folding into one, even after their lints ran, until CI finishes on main. The lane's homes must say so. After a fold the combined head is linted again, since it is a new head (triage reading; unchecked).
